card.name: Spots right before an opening quote
card.fires_on: Words or word parts just before an opening quotation mark or quoted term, such as dictionary pronunciation marks, a name before a quote, or "look up" before a quoted phrase.

modes.label: Dictionary headword spellings
modes.description: Partway through a syllable-split headword in a dictionary entry, right before a pronunciation quote mark.

modes.label: Lead-in before a quoted item
modes.description: A word that introduces a quoted phrase, term or speech.
modes.example: What made you want to look<< up>> "Aleutian low"? Please share

modes.label: Parts of a name before a quote
modes.description: Inside or just after a person's name where a quoted statement follows.
modes.example: "Sometimes it's the only decision they can make when the rent is due," Drewn<<ows>>ky said.

card.writes: It raises the chance that the next token is an opening quotation mark, often with a bracket before it.
card.plain: It fires where the text is about to open a quotation mark.
